title: fix(lint): flow-region-shape-invalid points at the region container at fault
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Ja6arWBs4nMY35SgDhwmfH)_
Fixes #29558

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`flow-region-shape-invalid` 的发现不再只指向整个流程,而是指向引擎拒收时点名的那个区域容器(并行、循环、try_catch),路径与 where 都落到该节点。
- 为什么改:作者只看到「这个流程有问题」,找不到是哪个容器形状不对;引擎现在随拒收抛出带路径和节点 id 的 `FlowRegionShapeError`,lint 直接读它。
- 风险与回滚:只动发现的定位,消息原文一字未改;读不到该错误类型时退回整流程定位。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-flow-region-shape.ts` 的 `containerAtFault()`,其后是同目录测试文件里新增的三个容器用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`,预期 10/10 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`validateFlowRegionShape` (`packages/lint/src/validate-flow-region-shape.ts`) now anchors its finding on the region container the engine's refusal names. Since #29719 (PR #29789), `validateControlFlow` throws the exported `FlowRegionShapeError`, carrying the container's `nodeId` and its `path` inside the flow. The new `containerAtFault()` reads both with one `instanceof FlowRegionShapeError` check:

- `path` becomes the flow path plus the container path, in lint spelling: `flows[1]` + `['nodes', 1, 'config', 'try', 'nodes', 0]` gives `flows[1].nodes[1].config.try.nodes[0]` (`spellPath()`).
- `where` becomes `flow 'NAME' › node 'ID'`.
- `message` is unchanged: still the engine's sentence behind the flow's name. Still one rule, one judge, one spelling: there is no second call and nothing parses the sentence.
- Any other error the engine throws names no container, so the flow stays the anchor, as before. A flow the flow schema refuses is unchanged too: it was never judged, so no container exists.

**One finding per flow, which is one finding per container.** The engine throws once, at a flow's first malformed region, and the rule makes exactly the engine's call. Reporting further containers would need a second walk beside the engine's, which the card rules out. A flow with two malformed regions therefore still takes two fixes, as the rule's explanation already says.

**Forced path-only pin moves**, each limited to the asserted path (claim 6593246940, amendments 6593285300 and the one adding the dogfood file):

- `packages/cli/test/validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`: the assembled-artifact case's `flows[1]` → `flows[1].nodes[1]`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.flow-region.test.ts`: three cases move from `flows[0]` to the container.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`: the draft read's item-relative path `''` → `nodes.1.config.try.nodes.0`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-region-malformed-publish.dogfood.test.ts`: the draft read's `"path":""` → `"path":"nodes.1"`, its comment, and one docblock phrase.

A `@objectstack/lint` patch changeset carries the move.

## Why

The card: an author reading `flow-region-shape-invalid` learned only that the flow was refused, not which `parallel`, `loop` or `try_catch` was malformed. The location now comes from the contract the spec half (#29719) added, not from the sentence.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`: three new cases under `[#29558]` (a top-level `try_catch`, a one-branch `parallel` nested in a try region, a `loop` inside the second branch of a `parallel`), plus the first case and the non-record-entry case moved to the container path. 10/10.

All at head `ccbd58d4`, each under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, verdict line quoted:

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 192 passed (192), Tests 7945 passed (7945). The lint typecheck covers its tests (`check:test-typecheck`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Tests 10 passed (10).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 test/validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Tests 7 passed (7). `authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts` is integration tier and unedited, so it is left to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/runtime-authoring-gate.flow-region.test.ts src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` (after a lint build): VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 57 passed (57).
- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/flow-region-malformed-publish.dogfood.test.ts`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Tests 3 passed (3).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the reader)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the reader's one line (the `instanceof FlowRegionShapeError` return) with `return undefined;`: anchor x1 to x0, blob `37494f85f3c3` to `122265b776ae`. The rule's test file then went red, Tests 5 failed, 5 passed: the first case, the three `[#29558]` container cases and the non-record-entry case. Restored by the tool: blob after restore `37494f85f3c3` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the rule from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The resume commit (`56820bac`, cherry-picked as `b9930969`) missed one in-file pin, the non-record-entry case (`flows[2]` → `flows[2].nodes[1]`); fixed in its own commit.
- The rule's `os explain` entry (`rule-explanations.ts`) says nothing about the location, so it was left alone.
